what: A zipper between top and bottom covers over the screen is opened by scrolling. The section is pinned for 150% (scrub 1). During the first 40% the zipper pull moves from the right end to the left end and the tooth line is erased from the right. During the next 40% the top cover goes up 89% and the bottom cover goes down 89% (power1.in), parting to reveal the inner image and button, and the last 20% stays open.

options.[data-fx-part=zip]: (if present) zipper panel — disappears at .06 when the cover splits
options.[data-fx-part=chain]: (If present) Tooth row — erased from the right
options.[data-fx-part=slider]: (if present) ring — shifted left by the panel width (xPercent −101). Clipped so only the right-end 3.5% shows
options.split: Share where the cover splits (%), default 89
